title: Processing errors on notification-svc

detection.alert: notification-svc: error-log rate > 20/min (CloudWatch Logs metric filter)

impact: Background processing failed; customer-visible data was delayed or wrong on notification-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] notification-svc 2026-05-30 01:43-06:33: notification-svc: 322 of 423 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-30 01:43 and 2026-05-30 06:33 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span.
error_templates: [ERROR] webhook delivery failed endpoint=hooks.acme.example.com: SSLError certificate verify failed: certificate has expired

_templates.macro: No change explains the anomaly: the TLS certificate of a large customer's webhook endpoint expired.
_templates.remediation: No rollback needed; the customer renewed the certificate; webhook failures for that endpoint are now alerted separately.
